description_en: Modifies the AD domain information about an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance
description_zh: 该接口用于修改RDS SQL Server实例的AD域信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-ad-info --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyADInfo

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The DNS information about the AD domain
parameters.name: ad_dns

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the AD domain
parameters.name: ad_server_ip_address

parameters.help_en: The account of the AD domain
parameters.name: ad_account_name

parameters.help_en: The password for the account of the AD domain
parameters.name: ad_password
